description: Source code implementing DER encoding functions for time values, including conversion between base::Time, POSIX time, and DER GeneralizedTime/UTCTime formats.

methods.name: WriteFourDigit
methods.description: Helper function to write a four-digit number into a byte array.

methods.name: WriteTwoDigit
methods.description: Helper function to write a two-digit number into a byte array.

methods.name: EncodeTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a base::Time object into a GeneralizedTime structure.

methods.name: EncodePosixTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Converts POSIX time to GeneralizedTime structure.

methods.name: GeneralizedTimeToTime
methods.description: Converts a DER GeneralizedTime to base::Time.

methods.name: GeneralizedTimeToPosixTime
methods.description: Converts a DER GeneralizedTime to POSIX time.

methods.name: EncodeGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime structure into a byte array.

methods.name: EncodeUTCTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime structure into a UTC Time byte array.
